annotation.authors_or_issuer: The IEEE Global Initiative on Ethics of Autonomous and Intelligent Systems
key_provisions_or_claims: Prioritize human well-being as the metric of progress for autonomous and intelligent systems.
Embed human rights, transparency, accountability and awareness of misuse into A/IS design.
Calls for meaningful human control over autonomous weapons systems.
Recommends personal data access control and individual data agency.
Inspires IEEE P7000 series standards and certification programs.
annotation.summary_en: IEEE Global Initiative's Ethically Aligned Design Version 2 (public-discussion draft): a broad framework of issues and candidate recommendations for prioritizing human well-being in autonomous and intelligent systems. It covers general principles, values embedding, AGI, personal data, autonomous weapons, economics, law, affective computing, policy and well-being, and informs IEEE P7000 standards.
